title: Target controllability for a minimum time problem in a trait-structured chemostat model
summary: In this paper, we consider a minimum time control problem governed by a trait-structured chemostat model including mutation and one limiting substrate. Our first main result proves the well-posedness of the control-to-state mapping. We subsequently analyze the class of auxostat-type controls, feedback laws designed to regulate substrate concentration, and prove that the corresponding solutions converge to a stationary state of the system.
